display_title: What if I Married My Enemy?
description:
Following a wild night with a handsome stranger, Camilla thinks she'll never see him again. But she soon realizes he's Astor Blanche, the bastard son of an enemy family and her fiancé who left for war years ago. Horrified, Camilla tries to call off the engagement she never wanted, but Astor insists that she take responsibility for taking his virginity! Having no other choice, Camilla decides to use this marriage to get revenge on the evil Blanche Family. Although Astor is eager to help, his condition is that she fulfill her duty as his wife, especially in the bedroom...

(Source: Tappytoon)
